messages:
Clara (marketing): Hi @eng-runtime — we need a small, auditable bench bundle for the launch post and webinar. Deliverables: per-request CSVs, aggregated KPIs, cold vs warm profiles, and a one-paragraph runbook. Also a single-slide-ready table. Deadline: Wednesday EOD.

artifact-bot: enqueue job 7204 - ingesting payloads from drive:/marketing/launch/mini_payloads.jsonl

Omar (eng-runtime): Can do. Two quick Qs: (1) which model variants? (2) what demo thresholds do you want us to flag?

Clara (marketing): Include fp16 baseline and int8-quant fast kernel. Optional: small 3B fallback. KPI thresholds: median gen <= 270ms for <=64 tokens, embed p50 <= 35ms. Mark any miss as FAIL in summary.

Lina (eng-runtime): We'll run batch=1 for the slide numbers; we'll also run batch=2 as an appendix. Warm runs = 5 synthetic warmup requests; cold runs = strict. We'll include a 7% random holdout and record the RNG seed in manifest.txt.

Omar (eng-runtime): Deliverables: artifacts.zip with runs/*.csv, summary.csv (p50/p90/p95/p99 + pass_fail), manifest.txt (holdout seed), runbook.md, traces.tar.gz. ETA Wednesday 18:00.

Clara (marketing): 7% holdout noted. Please do not cherry-pick samples. Also include a one-line method blurb we can paste in the blog: how we measured embedding latency and warmup definition.

artifact-bot: job 7204 -> ingest complete: 36 payloads detected, artifacts staged at /artifacts/7204

Lina (eng-runtime): Smoke running now. Example CSV excerpt (per-request):

```
req_id,variant,warmup,total_ms,model_ms,tokens
p001,fp16,false,410,395,48
p002,int8,true,185,170,32
p003,fp16,false,1220,1205,1300
```

Omar (eng-runtime): We'll include the exact run command in runbook.md (edited for public):

```
bench-run --model redwood-7b-v2 --variant int8 --batch 1 --warmup 5 --payloads payloads.jsonl --out runs/warm_int8.csv
```

Clara (marketing): Great. When you upload artifacts.zip, ping #marketing with a short checklist: artifacts present, manifest with seed, slide-ready CSV, runbook included. We'll validate the 7% holdout and then finalize slide copy. Thanks! :thumbsup:
